method: Current official web pages and author documentation; no model, chemical analysis or hardware experiment performed.
inferences: RGB-D cannot uniquely recover arbitrary hidden composition from the described surface observations.
RGB plus calibrated weight should be tested as the task-specific baseline before buying depth enhancement.
Batch-average nutrition requires additional representative-serving assumptions at portion level.
